text:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a planned maintenance for us-west3 on Sat 2025-11-22 03:00 UTC. Rolling node reboots + PDU swap for racks r12-r14. Affects GPU pools: vulcan (priority), nova (best-effort). Staggered drain, target 90m window. Will do 10 nodes/minute, KV-cache seed after each cohort. Will post runbook and inc ID.
kevin: rough capacity hit?
maria: expected ~12% transient capacity loss in vulcan during peak; plan is to backfill from reserve pool 'ember' and allow burst to dedicated tenants. Fallback: route low-priority jobs to quantized-2 model variant.
liyah: oncall — I can cover first half, @sam can you take the second half?
sam: I can take the second half. Also need SLO impact calc for dataplane — any estimate on tail-latency spikes?
maria: tail-latency may see +50–200ms p95 on small-gen requests during KV reseed, p99 should be rare. We'll enable prefix-cache warming and throttled canaries.
kevin: cost — how much burst/spot will we burn? need an estimate for finance.
maria: estimate ~$1.2k for burst capacity across 90m based on current usage. I'll add to the maintenance ticket.
sam: add note to avoid scheduling new CUDA-heavy batch jobs during window. We'll block batch queuing from 02:30-05:00 UTC.
maria: ops drain command for the runbook (ops team):
```bash
fleetctl drain --pool vulcan --cohort-size 10 --grace 300 --stagger 6s --post-hook ./kvseed.sh
```
maria: post-hook seeds KV cache: `kvseed.sh --pool vulcan --keys 200k`
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance INC-2025-462 created by maria — page policy: standard; customer notifications: 2h and 30m reminders.
devex: please add the runbook link and a minimal rollback plan to the inc ticket. I'll also prep a short status blurb for the status page.
liyah: added to calendar, will ping product teams & large tenants and run a quick canary 15m before starting.
kevin: :thumbsup: include a one-line escalation matrix: who to call if PDU swap fails or backfill doesn't come up.
maria: good call — will add. Final callout: ensure model routing policy prefers fallback variants for 30m after the window to absorb cache warmup.
sam: acknowledged. I'll watch synthetic checks and tail logs.
maria: thanks all — will post final confirmation 2h before start.
